siche@ikz-berlin.de.name: apl. Prof. Dr. Dietmar Siche
siche@ikz-berlin.de.title: Außerplanmäßiger Professor (非编教授)
siche@ikz-berlin.de.research_interests: apl. Prof. Dr. Dietmar Siche is a leading expert in crystal growth technology. His research focuses on plasma-assisted growth of perfect GaN crystals, heavily-doped Germanium single crystals for mid-Infrared applications, and CuFeO2 single crystal growth using the optical floating-zone technique. He also investigates phosphorus distribution in multi-crystalline silicon using travelling magnetic fields. Dr. Siche teaches crystal growth technology at Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg and has served as chair of the IWCGT-7 (International Workshop on Crystal Growth Technology) conference.
